advice.headline: Make a trade

moves.text: Offer jsous: Mike Gesicki + George Pickens for Colston Loveland.
Pick up Gardner Minshew II off waivers (+1.6 points a week) and drop Cade Otton.

reasons: You're 6-1 and make the playoffs in >99% of simulated seasons. Your title chance is 14%.
Your projected playoff-week lineup ranks 3rd of 11 contenders (147.9 points a week).
Your weakest position is QB (6th of 12), so that's where an upgrade helps most.
Looking ahead, your roster projects 3rd in 2026, 1st in 2027 and 2nd in 2028 (title chances about 14%, 25%, 24%), after aging and the rookies your picks will bring.
Your roster holds up for the next two seasons too, so you can afford to push for titles now.

That trade raises your title chance from 14% to 17%, and your lineup comes out 3.0 points a week ahead overall. Mike Gesicki + George Pickens add 1.3 points a week for you today, but Colston Loveland is worth more to your lineup.
The trade values are close enough for them to say yes (you give 4,913, get 4,230), and it helps their lineup too (+2.0 a week), which makes it an easy sell.
It doesn't cost your future: title chances in the next two seasons go from 25% and 24% to 25% and 22%.
You have 6 weeks until the trade deadline.
watch: Week 8 is your weakest projected week (143 points vs your usual 157), mostly byes.
Jayden Daniels's trade value has dropped 12% in 11 days.
Lamar Jackson's trade value has dropped 27% in 11 days.
Tee Higgins's trade value has dropped 24% in 11 days.
Isaiah Likely's trade value has dropped 42% in 11 days.
